120static inline bool isIntegerDepth(int depth)
121{
122 return depth == CV_8U || depth == CV_8S || depth == CV_16U || depth == CV_16S ||
123 depth == CV_32U || depth == CV_32S || depth == CV_64U || depth == CV_64S;
124}
125
126static inline bool isUnsignedDepth(int depth)
127{
128 return depth == CV_8U || depth == CV_16U || depth == CV_32U || depth == CV_64U;
129}

131template<typename T> static inline T intAbs(T x, std::true_type)
132{
133 // Negating the type's minimum is undefined; the unsigned round trip wraps instead.
134 typedef typename std::make_unsigned<T>::type UT;
135 return x < 0 ? (T)(UT(0) - (UT)x) : x;
136}
137
138template<typename T> static inline T intAbs(T x, std::false_type) { return x; }
139
140template<typename T> static inline T intSign(T x, std::true_type) { return (T)((x > 0) - (x < 0)); }
141
142template<typename T> static inline T intSign(T x, std::false_type) { return (T)(x != 0); }
143
144struct IntAbsOp
145{
146 template<typename T> static inline T apply(T x)
147 {
148 return intAbs(x, std::integral_constant<bool, std::numeric_limits<T>::is_signed>());
149 }
150};
151
152struct IntSignOp
153{
154 template<typename T> static inline T apply(T x)
155 {
156 return intSign(x, std::integral_constant<bool, std::numeric_limits<T>::is_signed>());
157 }
158};

160template<typename Body> static inline void blockedParallelFor(size_t total, Body&& body)
161{
162 const size_t BLOCK_SIZE = 1 << 16;
163 parallel_for_(Range(0, (int)((total + BLOCK_SIZE - 1) / BLOCK_SIZE)),
164 [&](const Range& r)
165 {
166 for (int b = r.start; b < r.end; b++)
167 {
168 size_t start = (size_t)b * BLOCK_SIZE;
169 body(start, std::min(BLOCK_SIZE, total - start));
170 }
171 });
172}
173
174template<typename T, typename Op> static inline void intUnaryKernel(const Mat& src, Mat& dst)
175{
176 const T* srcptr = src.ptr<T>();
177 T* dstptr = dst.ptr<T>();
178
179 blockedParallelFor(src.total(), [&](size_t start, size_t len)
180 {
181 for (size_t i = start; i < start + len; i++)
182 dstptr[i] = Op::apply(srcptr[i]);
183 });
184}
185
186template<typename Op> static inline bool intUnaryDispatch(const Mat& src, Mat& dst)
187{
188 if (src.type() != dst.type())
189 return false;
190
191 switch (src.depth())
192 {
193 case CV_8U: intUnaryKernel<uint8_t, Op>(src, dst); break;
194 case CV_8S: intUnaryKernel<int8_t, Op>(src, dst); break;
195 case CV_16U: intUnaryKernel<uint16_t, Op>(src, dst); break;
196 case CV_16S: intUnaryKernel<int16_t, Op>(src, dst); break;
197 case CV_32U: intUnaryKernel<uint32_t, Op>(src, dst); break;
198 case CV_32S: intUnaryKernel<int32_t, Op>(src, dst); break;
199 case CV_64U: intUnaryKernel<uint64_t, Op>(src, dst); break;
200 case CV_64S: intUnaryKernel<int64_t, Op>(src, dst); break;
201 default: return false;
202 }
203 return true;
204}

206template<typename Func>
207class ElementWiseLayer : public Func::Layer
208{
209public:
210 class PBody : public cv::ParallelLoopBody
211 {
212 public:
213 const Func* func_;
214 const Mat* src_;
215 Mat* dst_;
216 int nstripes_;
217
218 PBody(const Func &func, const Mat &src, Mat& dst, int nstripes)
219 {
220 func_ = &func;
221 src_ = &src;
222 dst_ = &dst;
223 nstripes_ = nstripes;
224 }
225
226 void operator()(const Range &r) const CV_OVERRIDE
227 {
228 int nstripes = nstripes_, nsamples = 1, outCn = 1;
229 size_t planeSize = 1;
230
231 if (src_->dims > 1)
232 {
233 nsamples = src_->size[0];
234 outCn = src_->size[1];
235 }
236 else
237 outCn = src_->size[0];
238
239 for (int i = 2; i < src_->dims; ++i)
240 planeSize *= src_->size[i];
241
242 size_t stripeSize = (planeSize + nstripes - 1)/nstripes;
243 size_t stripeStart = r.start*stripeSize;
244 size_t stripeEnd = std::min(r.end*stripeSize, planeSize);
245
246 for( int i = 0; i < nsamples; i++ )
247 {
248 const float* srcptr = src_->ptr<float>(i) + stripeStart;
249 float* dstptr = dst_->ptr<float>(i) + stripeStart;
250 func_->apply(srcptr, dstptr, stripeStart, (int)(stripeEnd - stripeStart), planeSize, 0, outCn);
251 }
252 }
253 };

316 void getTypes(const std::vector<MatType>& inputs,
317 const int requiredOutputs,
318 const int requiredInternals,
319 std::vector<MatType>& outputs,
320 std::vector<MatType>& internals) const CV_OVERRIDE
321 {
322 CV_Assert(inputs.size());
323 for (auto input : inputs)
324 {
325 // Types the functor has no integer kernel for follow the default gate.
326 if (!ElementWiseIntDispatch<Func>::supports(func, input))
327 {
328 LayerInfo::getTypes(inputs, requiredOutputs, requiredInternals, outputs, internals);
329 return;
330 }
331 }
332
333 outputs.assign(requiredOutputs, inputs[0]);
334 internals.assign(requiredInternals, inputs[0]);
335 }
336
337 void forward(InputArrayOfArrays inputs_arr, OutputArrayOfArrays outputs_arr, OutputArrayOfArrays internals_arr) CV_OVERRIDE
338 {
339 CV_TRACE_FUNCTION();
340
341 // The OCL kernels compute in float, which would silently round wide integers.
342 CV_OCL_RUN(IS_DNN_OPENCL_TARGET(this->preferableTarget) && !isIntegerDepth(inputs_arr.depth()),
343 func.applyOCL(inputs_arr, outputs_arr, internals_arr))
344
345 if (inputs_arr.depth() == CV_16F)
346 {
347 Layer::forward_fallback(inputs_arr, outputs_arr, internals_arr);
348 return;
349 }
350
351 std::vector<Mat> inputs, outputs;
352 inputs_arr.getMatVector(inputs);
353 outputs_arr.getMatVector(outputs);
354
355 for (size_t i = 0; i < inputs.size(); i++)
356 {
357 const Mat &src = inputs[i];
358 Mat &dst = outputs[i];
359
360 if (src.total() == 0)
361 continue;
362
363 CV_Assert_N(src.size == dst.size, src.isContinuous(), dst.isContinuous());
364
365 if (ElementWiseIntDispatch<Func>::apply(func, src, dst))
366 continue;
367
368 if (src.type() == CV_32F && dst.type() == CV_32F)
369 {
370 // Try fast activation function path first
371 std::vector<float> activParams_;
372 ActivationFunc activFunc = func.getActivationFunc(CV_32F, activParams_);
373 if (activFunc) {
374 const float* params = activParams_.empty() ? nullptr : activParams_.data();
375 size_t total = src.total();
376 const float* srcptr = src.ptr<float>();
377 float* dstptr = dst.ptr<float>();
378
379 blockedParallelFor(total, [&](size_t start, size_t len) {
380 activFunc(srcptr + start, dstptr + start, len, params);
381 });
382 continue;
383 }
384
385 const int nstripes = getNumThreads();
386 PBody body(func, src, dst, nstripes);
387 parallel_for_(Range(0, nstripes), body, nstripes);
388 continue;
389 }
390
391 if (src.type() == CV_64F && dst.type() == CV_64F)
392 {
393 Mat src_f, dst_f(dst.size, CV_32F);
394 src.convertTo(src_f, CV_32F);
395 const int nstripes = getNumThreads();
396 PBody body(func, src_f, dst_f, nstripes);
397 parallel_for_(Range(0, nstripes), body, nstripes);
398 dst_f.convertTo(dst, CV_64F);
399 continue;
400 }
401
402 CV_Error(Error::StsUnsupportedFormat, "ElementWiseLayer: unsupported input/output type; expected CV_32F or CV_64F.");
403 }
404 }

428 virtual int64 getFLOPS(const std::vector<MatShape> &inputs,
429 const std::vector<MatShape> &outputs) const CV_OVERRIDE
430 {
431 long flops = 0;

466struct ReLUFunctor : public BaseFunctor
467{
468 typedef ReLULayer Layer;
469 float slope;
470
471 explicit ReLUFunctor(float slope_=1.f) : slope(slope_) {}
472
473 ActivationFunc getActivationFunc(int depth, std::vector<float>& activParams) const
474 {
475 if (depth != CV_32F) return nullptr;

481 {
482#ifdef HAVE_DNN_NGRAPH
483 if (backendId == DNN_BACKEND_INFERENCE_ENGINE_NGRAPH)
484 return true;
485#endif
486#ifdef HAVE_WEBNN
487 if (backendId == DNN_BACKEND_WEBNN) {
488 // TODO: support PRELU
489 if (slope != 0)
490 {
491 CV_LOG_WARNING(NULL, "PRELU is not supported now.");
492 }
493 return slope == 0;

495#endif

501 void apply(const float* srcptr, float* dstptr, int stripeStart, int len, size_t planeSize, int cn0, int cn1) const
502 {
503 CV_UNUSED(stripeStart);
504 float s = slope;
505 for( int cn = cn0; cn < cn1; cn++, srcptr += planeSize, dstptr += planeSize )
506 {
507 int i = 0;
508#if CV_SIMD128
509 v_float32x4 s4 = v_setall_f32(s), z = v_setzero_f32();
510 for( ; i <= len - 16; i += 16 )
511 {
512 v_float32x4 x0 = v_load(srcptr + i);
513 v_float32x4 x1 = v_load(srcptr + i + 4);
514 v_float32x4 x2 = v_load(srcptr + i + 8);
515 v_float32x4 x3 = v_load(srcptr + i + 12);
516 x0 = v_select(v_ge(x0, z), x0, v_mul(x0, s4));
517 x1 = v_select(v_ge(x1, z), x1, v_mul(x1, s4));
518 x2 = v_select(v_ge(x2, z), x2, v_mul(x2, s4));
519 x3 = v_select(v_ge(x3, z), x3, v_mul(x3, s4));
520 v_store(dstptr + i, x0);
521 v_store(dstptr + i + 4, x1);
522 v_store(dstptr + i + 8, x2);
523 v_store(dstptr + i + 12, x3);
524 }
525#endif
526 for( ; i < len; i++ )
527 {
528 float x = srcptr[i];
529 dstptr[i] = x >= 0.f ? x : s*x;
530 }
531 }
532 }

541#ifdef HAVE_OPENCL
542 bool initKernel(ocl::Kernel &ker, const UMat &src) const
543 {
544 const char *buildoptSlope = (slope == 0) ? "-DRELU_NO_SLOPE" : "";
545 String buildopt = oclGetTMacro(src) + buildoptSlope;
546

552

556 bool applyOCL(InputArrayOfArrays inps, OutputArrayOfArrays outs, OutputArrayOfArrays internals)
557 {
558 std::vector<UMat> inputs;
559 std::vector<UMat> outputs;
560
561 inps.getUMatVector(inputs);
562 outs.getUMatVector(outputs);
563
564 for (size_t i = 0; i < inputs.size(); i++)
565 {
566 UMat& src = inputs[i];
567 UMat& dst = outputs[i];
568 CV_Assert(src.isContinuous() && dst.isContinuous() && !src.offset && !dst.offset);
569
570 ocl::Kernel kernel;
571 CV_Assert(initKernel(kernel, src));
572 kernel.set(0, (int)src.total());
573 kernel.set(1, ocl::KernelArg::PtrReadOnly(src));
574 kernel.set(2, ocl::KernelArg::PtrWriteOnly(dst));
575
576 size_t gSize = src.total();
577 CV_Assert(kernel.run(1, &gSize, NULL, false));
578 }
579
580 return true;
581 }
582#endif

585 Ptr<BackendNode> initCannOp(const std::string& name,
586 const std::vector<Ptr<BackendWrapper> > &inputs,
587 const std::vector<Ptr<BackendNode> >& nodes)
588 {
589 auto x = inputs[0].dynamicCast<CannBackendWrapper>();
590 auto op_x = nodes[0].dynamicCast<CannBackendNode>()->getOp();
591 auto x_desc = x->getTensorDesc();
592
593 auto output_desc = std::make_shared<ge::TensorDesc>(ge::Shape(), ge::FORMAT_NCHW, ge::DT_FLOAT);
594
595 if (slope)
596 {
597 auto op = std::make_shared<ge::op::LeakyRelu>(name);
598
599 op->set_input_x_by_name(*op_x, x->name.c_str());
600 op->update_input_desc_x(*x_desc);
601
602 op->set_attr_negative_slope(slope);
603
604 op->update_output_desc_y(*output_desc);
605
606 return Ptr<BackendNode>(new CannBackendNode(op));
607 }
608
609 auto op = std::make_shared<ge::op::Relu>(name);
610
611 op->set_input_x_by_name(*op_x, x->name.c_str());
612 op->update_input_desc_x(*x_desc);
613
614 op->update_output_desc_y(*output_desc);
615
616 return Ptr<BackendNode>(new CannBackendNode(op));
617 }

671 void apply(const float* srcptr, float* dstptr, int stripeStart, int len, size_t planeSize, int cn0, int cn1) const
672 {
673 CV_UNUSED(stripeStart);
674 for( int cn = cn0; cn < cn1; cn++, srcptr += planeSize, dstptr += planeSize )
675 {
676 int i = 0;
677#if CV_SIMD128
678 v_float32x4 minV = v_setall_f32(minValue), maxV = v_setall_f32(maxValue);
679 for( ; i <= len - 16; i += 16 )
680 {
681 v_float32x4 x0 = v_load(srcptr + i);
682 v_float32x4 x1 = v_load(srcptr + i + 4);
683 v_float32x4 x2 = v_load(srcptr + i + 8);
684 v_float32x4 x3 = v_load(srcptr + i + 12);
685 x0 = v_min(v_max(minV, x0), maxV);
686 x1 = v_min(v_max(minV, x1), maxV);
687 x2 = v_min(v_max(minV, x2), maxV);
688 x3 = v_min(v_max(minV, x3), maxV);
689 v_store(dstptr + i, x0);
690 v_store(dstptr + i + 4, x1);
691 v_store(dstptr + i + 8, x2);
692 v_store(dstptr + i + 12, x3);
693 }
694#endif
695 for( ; i < len; i++ )
696 {
697 float x = srcptr[i];
698 if (x >= minValue)
699 dstptr[i] = x <= maxValue ? x : maxValue;
700 else
701 dstptr[i] = minValue;
702 }
703 }
704 }

798template <class T>
799struct BaseDefaultFunctor : public BaseFunctor
800{
801 void apply(const float* srcptr, float* dstptr, int stripeStart, int len, size_t planeSize, int cn0, int cn1) const
802 {
803 CV_UNUSED(stripeStart);
804 for( int cn = cn0; cn < cn1; cn++, srcptr += planeSize, dstptr += planeSize )
805 {
806 for( int i = 0; i < len; i++ )
807 {
808 float x = srcptr[i];
809 dstptr[i] = static_cast<const T*>(this)->calculate(x);
810 }
811 }
812 }

879namespace {
880 // Refer to v_erf in modules/core/include/opencv2/core/hal/intrin_math.hpp
881 constexpr float c_erf_coef0 = 0.3275911f;
882 constexpr float c_erf_coef1 = 1.061405429f;
883 constexpr float c_erf_coef2 = -1.453152027f;
884 constexpr float c_erf_coef3 = 1.421413741f;
885 constexpr float c_erf_coef4 = -0.284496736f;
886 constexpr float c_erf_coef5 = 0.254829592f;
887
888 inline float erf_approx(float v) {
889 float t = 1.f / fmaf(fabsf(v), c_erf_coef0, 1.f);
890 float r = fmaf(c_erf_coef1, t, c_erf_coef2);
891 r = fmaf(r, t, c_erf_coef3);
892 r = fmaf(r, t, c_erf_coef4);
893 r = fmaf(r, t, c_erf_coef5);
894 r = 1.f - r * t * expf(-v * v);
895 return std::copysignf(r, v);
896 }
897}
898
899struct GeluFunctor : public BaseFunctor {
900 using Layer = GeluLayer;
901 int vlanes;
902
903 explicit GeluFunctor() {
904#if (CV_SIMD || CV_SIMD_SCALABLE)
905 vlanes = VTraits<v_float32>::vlanes();
906#else
907 vlanes = 1;
908#endif
909 }
910
911 ActivationFunc getActivationFunc(int depth, std::vector<float>& activParams) const
912 {
913 if (depth != CV_32F) return nullptr;
914 activParams.clear();
915 return cv::dnn::getActivationFunc(ACTIV_GELU);
916 }
917
918 bool supportBackend(int backendId, int)
919 {
920 return backendId == DNN_BACKEND_OPENCV ||
921 backendId == DNN_BACKEND_CUDA ||
922 backendId == DNN_BACKEND_INFERENCE_ENGINE_NGRAPH ||
923 backendId == DNN_BACKEND_CANN;
924 }
925
926 void apply(const float* srcptr, float* dstptr, int stripeStart, int len, size_t planeSize, int cn0, int cn1) const {
927 CV_UNUSED(stripeStart);
928 for (int cn = cn0; cn < cn1; cn++, srcptr += planeSize, dstptr += planeSize) {
929 int i = 0;
930#if (CV_SIMD || CV_SIMD_SCALABLE)
931 // 0.5f * x * (1.0f + erf(x * M_SQRT1_2));
932 v_float32 half = vx_setall_f32(0.5f),
933 one = vx_setall_f32(1.0f),
934 reciprocal_sqrt2 = vx_setall_f32(M_SQRT1_2);
935 for (; i <= len - vlanes; i += vlanes) {
936 v_float32 x0 = vx_load(srcptr + i);
937
938 // t = x * M_SQRT1_2
939 v_float32 t0 = v_mul(reciprocal_sqrt2, x0);
940
941 // t = 1.0f + t
942 t0 = v_add(one, v_erf(t0));
943
944 // x = 0.5 * x
945 x0 = v_mul(half, x0);
946
947 // x = x * t
948 x0 = v_mul(x0, t0);
949
950 vx_store(dstptr + i, x0);
951 }
952#endif
953 // 0.5f * x * (1.0f + erf(x * M_SQRT1_2));
954 for( ; i < len; i++ )
955 {
956 float x = srcptr[i];
957 dstptr[i] = 0.5f * x * (1.0f + erf_approx(x * M_SQRT1_2));
958 }
959 }
960 }

1039namespace GeluApproximationConstants
1040{
1041 static constexpr float sqrt_2_pi = 0.7978845834732056f;
1042 static constexpr float coef_sqrt_2_pi = 0.044714998453855515f * sqrt_2_pi;
1043}
1044
1045struct GeluApproximationFunctor : public BaseDefaultFunctor<GeluApproximationFunctor>
1046{
1047 typedef GeluApproximationLayer Layer;
1048
1049 explicit GeluApproximationFunctor() {}
1050
1051 ActivationFunc getActivationFunc(int depth, std::vector<float>& activParams) const
1052 {
1053 if (depth != CV_32F) return nullptr;
1054 activParams.clear();
1055 return cv::dnn::getActivationFunc(ACTIV_GELU_APPROX);
1056 }
1057
1058 bool supportBackend(int backendId, int)
1059 {
1060 return backendId == DNN_BACKEND_OPENCV;
1061 }
1062
1063 inline float calculate(float x) const
1064 {
1065 return 0.5f * x * (1.f + tanh(x * (GeluApproximationConstants::sqrt_2_pi +
1066 GeluApproximationConstants::coef_sqrt_2_pi * x * x)));
1067 }
1068
1069 void apply(const float* srcptr, float* dstptr, int stripeStart, int len, size_t planeSize, int cn0, int cn1) const
1070 {
1071 CV_UNUSED(stripeStart);
1072 for (int cn = cn0; cn < cn1; cn++, srcptr += planeSize, dstptr += planeSize)
1073 {
1074 int i = 0;
1075#if (CV_SIMD || CV_SIMD_SCALABLE)
1076 const int vlanes = VTraits<v_float32>::vlanes();
1077 v_float32 one = vx_setall_f32(1.f), two = vx_setall_f32(2.f), half = vx_setall_f32(0.5f);
1078 v_float32 c1 = vx_setall_f32(GeluApproximationConstants::sqrt_2_pi);
1079 v_float32 c2 = vx_setall_f32(GeluApproximationConstants::coef_sqrt_2_pi);
1080 v_float32 lo = vx_setall_f32(-88.f), hi = vx_setall_f32(88.f);
1081 for (; i <= len - vlanes; i += vlanes)
1082 {
1083 v_float32 x = vx_load(srcptr + i);
1084 v_float32 u = v_mul(x, v_fma(v_mul(x, x), c2, c1));
1085 v_float32 e = v_exp(v_min(v_max(v_add(u, u), lo), hi));
1086 v_float32 th = v_sub(one, v_div(two, v_add(e, one)));
1087 vx_store(dstptr + i, v_mul(v_mul(half, x), v_add(one, th)));
1088 }
1089#endif
1090 for (; i < len; i++)
1091 dstptr[i] = calculate(srcptr[i]);
1092 }
1093 }
1094
1095 int64 getFLOPSPerElement() const { return 100; }
1096};
1097

1101struct TanHFunctor : public BaseDefaultFunctor<TanHFunctor>
1102{
1103 typedef TanHLayer Layer;
1104
1105 ActivationFunc getActivationFunc(int depth, std::vector<float>& activParams) const
1106 {
1107 if (depth != CV_32F) return nullptr;
1108 activParams.clear();
1109 return cv::dnn::getActivationFunc(ACTIV_TANH);
1110 }
1111
1112 bool supportBackend(int backendId, int)
1113 {
1114#ifdef HAVE_INF_ENGINE
1115 if (backendId == DNN_BACKEND_INFERENCE_ENGINE_NGRAPH)
1116 return true;
1117#endif
1118 return backendId == DNN_BACKEND_OPENCV ||
1119 backendId == DNN_BACKEND_CUDA ||
1120 backendId == DNN_BACKEND_CANN;
1121 }
1122
1123 inline float calculate(float x) const
1124 {
1125 return tanh(x);
1126 }
1127
1128 void apply(const float* srcptr, float* dstptr, int stripeStart, int len, size_t planeSize, int cn0, int cn1) const
1129 {
1130 CV_UNUSED(stripeStart);
1131 for (int cn = cn0; cn < cn1; cn++, srcptr += planeSize, dstptr += planeSize)
1132 {
1133 int i = 0;
1134#if (CV_SIMD || CV_SIMD_SCALABLE)
1135 const int vlanes = VTraits<v_float32>::vlanes();
1136 v_float32 one = vx_setall_f32(1.f), two = vx_setall_f32(2.f);
1137 v_float32 lo = vx_setall_f32(-88.f), hi = vx_setall_f32(88.f);
1138 for (; i <= len - vlanes; i += vlanes)
1139 {
1140 v_float32 x = vx_load(srcptr + i);
1141 v_float32 e = v_exp(v_min(v_max(v_add(x, x), lo), hi)); // e^{2x}, clamped
1142 vx_store(dstptr + i, v_sub(one, v_div(two, v_add(e, one)))); // 1 - 2/(e+1)
1143 }
1144#endif
1145 for (; i < len; i++)
1146 dstptr[i] = calculate(srcptr[i]);
1147 }
1148 }

1191struct SwishFunctor : public BaseDefaultFunctor<SwishFunctor>
1192{
1193 using Layer = SwishLayer;
1194
1195 int vlanes;
1196
1197 explicit SwishFunctor() {
1198#if (CV_SIMD || CV_SIMD_SCALABLE)
1199 vlanes = VTraits<v_float32>::vlanes();
1200#else
1201 vlanes = 1;
1202#endif
1203 }
1204
1205 ActivationFunc getActivationFunc(int depth, std::vector<float>& activParams) const
1206 {
1207 if (depth != CV_32F) return nullptr;
1208 activParams.clear();
1209 return cv::dnn::getActivationFunc(ACTIV_SWISH);
1210 }
1211
1212 bool supportBackend(int backendId, int)
1213 {
1214 return backendId == DNN_BACKEND_OPENCV ||
1215 backendId == DNN_BACKEND_CUDA ||
1216 backendId == DNN_BACKEND_INFERENCE_ENGINE_NGRAPH ||
1217 backendId == DNN_BACKEND_CANN;
1218 }
1219
1220 inline float calculate(float x) const
1221 {
1222 return x / (1.f + exp(-x));
1223 }
1224
1225 void apply(const float* srcptr, float* dstptr, int stripeStart, int len, size_t planeSize, int cn0, int cn1) const {
1226 CV_UNUSED(stripeStart);
1227 for (int cn = cn0; cn < cn1; cn++, srcptr += planeSize, dstptr += planeSize) {
1228 int i = 0;
1229#if (CV_SIMD || CV_SIMD_SCALABLE)
1230 // x / (1.f + exp(-x));
1231 v_float32 one = vx_setall_f32(1.0f),
1232 zero = vx_setzero_f32();
1233 for (; i <= len - vlanes; i += vlanes) {
1234 v_float32 x = vx_load(srcptr + i);
1235
1236 v_float32 t = v_sub(zero, x);
1237 t = v_exp(t);
1238 t = v_add(one, t);
1239 t = v_div(x, t);
1240
1241 vx_store(dstptr + i, t);
1242 }
1243#endif
1244 // In case SIMD is not available or len < vlanes
1245 for (; i < len; i++) {
1246 dstptr[i] = calculate(srcptr[i]);
1247 }
1248 }
1249 }

1292template<>
1293const char* const SwishFunctor::BaseDefaultFunctor<SwishFunctor>::ocl_kernel_name = "SwishForward";
1294
1295namespace {
1296 constexpr float MISH_THRESHOLD = -36.73f;
1297}
1298
1299/*
1300 This implementation is derived from
1301 https://github.com/vpisarev/ficus/blob/3c9a8b78f49e17489c5e1fd6dd5dd487348c99c2/lib/NN/OpElemwise.fx#L110
1302*/
1303struct MishFunctor : public BaseDefaultFunctor<MishFunctor>
1304{
1305 using Layer = MishLayer;
1306
1307 int vlanes;
1308
1309 explicit MishFunctor() {
1310#if (CV_SIMD || CV_SIMD_SCALABLE)
1311 vlanes = VTraits<v_float32>::vlanes();
1312#else
1313 vlanes = 1;
1314#endif
1315 }
1316
1317 ActivationFunc getActivationFunc(int depth, std::vector<float>& activParams) const
1318 {
1319 if (depth != CV_32F) return nullptr;
1320 activParams.clear();
1321 return cv::dnn::getActivationFunc(ACTIV_MISH);
1322 }
1323
1324 bool supportBackend(int backendId, int)
1325 {
1326 return backendId == DNN_BACKEND_OPENCV ||
1327 backendId == DNN_BACKEND_CUDA ||
1328 backendId == DNN_BACKEND_INFERENCE_ENGINE_NGRAPH ||
1329 backendId == DNN_BACKEND_CANN;
1330 }
1331
1332 inline float calculate(float x) const
1333 {
1334 float y = x > MISH_THRESHOLD ? std::exp(-x) : 1.f;
1335 x *= x > MISH_THRESHOLD ? 1.f : 0.f;
1336 return x * (1 + 2 * y) / (1 + 2 * y + 2 * y * y);
1337 }
1338
1339 void apply(const float* srcptr, float* dstptr, int stripeStart, int len, size_t planeSize, int cn0, int cn1) const {
1340 CV_UNUSED(stripeStart);
1341 for (int cn = cn0; cn < cn1; cn++, srcptr += planeSize, dstptr += planeSize) {
1342 int i = 0;
1343#if (CV_SIMD || CV_SIMD_SCALABLE)
1344 v_float32 v_threshold = vx_setall_f32(MISH_THRESHOLD), one = vx_setall_f32(1.f), z = vx_setzero_f32();
1345 for (; i <= len - vlanes; i += vlanes) {
1346 v_float32 x = vx_load(srcptr + i);
1347
1348 x = v_select(v_le(x, v_threshold), z, x);
1349 v_float32 y = v_exp(v_sub(z, x));
1350 v_float32 _2y = v_add(y, y),
1351 _2ya1 = v_add(_2y, one);
1352 x = v_div(v_mul(x, _2ya1), v_add(_2ya1, v_mul(_2y, y)));
1353
1354 vx_store(dstptr + i, x);
1355 }
1356#endif
1357 // In case SIMD is not available or len < vlanes
1358 for (; i < len; i++) {
1359 dstptr[i] = calculate(srcptr[i]);
1360 }
1361 }
1362 }
1363

1366 {
1367 return make_cuda_node<cuda4dnn::MishOp>(target, stream);
1368 }
1369#endif

1405struct SigmoidFunctor : public BaseDefaultFunctor<SigmoidFunctor>
1406{
1407 typedef SigmoidLayer Layer;
1408
1409 ActivationFunc getActivationFunc(int depth, std::vector<float>& activParams) const
1410 {
1411 if (depth != CV_32F) return nullptr;
1412 activParams.clear();
1413 return cv::dnn::getActivationFunc(ACTIV_SIGMOID);
1414 }
1415
1416 bool supportBackend(int backendId, int)
1417 {
1418#ifdef HAVE_INF_ENGINE
1419 if (backendId == DNN_BACKEND_INFERENCE_ENGINE_NGRAPH)
1420 return true;
1421#endif
1422 return backendId == DNN_BACKEND_OPENCV ||
1423 backendId == DNN_BACKEND_CUDA ||
1424 backendId == DNN_BACKEND_CANN;
1425 }
1426
1427 inline float calculate(float x) const
1428 {
1429 float y;
1430 if (x >= 0)
1431 y = 1.f / (1.f + exp(-x));
1432 else {
1433 y = exp(x);
1434 y = y / (1 + y);
1435 }
1436 return y;
1437 }

1480struct ELUFunctor : public BaseDefaultFunctor<ELUFunctor>
1481{
1482 using Layer = ELULayer;
1483
1484 float alpha;
1485 int vlanes;
1486
1487 explicit ELUFunctor(float alpha_ = 1.f) : alpha(alpha_) {
1488#if (CV_SIMD || CV_SIMD_SCALABLE)
1489 vlanes = VTraits<v_float32>::vlanes();
1490#else
1491 vlanes = 1;
1492#endif
1493 }
1494
1495 ActivationFunc getActivationFunc(int depth, std::vector<float>& activParams) const
1496 {
1497 if (depth != CV_32F) return nullptr;
1498 activParams = {alpha};
1499 return cv::dnn::getActivationFunc(ACTIV_ELU);
1500 }
1501
1502 bool supportBackend(int backendId, int)
1503 {
1504#ifdef HAVE_INF_ENGINE
1505 if (backendId == DNN_BACKEND_INFERENCE_ENGINE_NGRAPH)
1506 return true;
1507#endif
1508 return backendId == DNN_BACKEND_OPENCV ||
1509 backendId == DNN_BACKEND_CUDA ||
1510 backendId == DNN_BACKEND_CANN;
1511 }
1512
1513 inline float calculate(float x) const
1514 {
1515 return x >= 0.f ? x : alpha * (exp(x) - 1.f);
1516 }
1517
1518 void apply(const float* srcptr, float* dstptr, int stripeStart, int len, size_t planeSize, int cn0, int cn1) const {
1519 CV_UNUSED(stripeStart);
1520 for (int cn = cn0; cn < cn1; cn++, srcptr += planeSize, dstptr += planeSize) {
1521 int i = 0;
1522#if (CV_SIMD || CV_SIMD_SCALABLE)
1523 v_float32 z = vx_setzero_f32(), v_alpha = vx_setall_f32(alpha), one = vx_setall_f32(1.0f);
1524 for (; i <= len - vlanes; i += vlanes) {
1525 v_float32 x = vx_load(srcptr + i);
1526
1527 v_float32 t = v_mul(v_alpha, v_sub(v_exp(x), one));
1528 x = v_select(v_ge(x, z), x, t);
1529
1530 vx_store(dstptr + i, x);
1531 }
1532#endif
1533 // In case SIMD is not available or len < vlanes
1534 for (; i < len; i++) {
1535 dstptr[i] = calculate(srcptr[i]);
1536 }
1537 }
1538 }
1539
1540 inline void setKernelParams(ocl::Kernel& kernel) const
1541 {
1542 kernel.set(3, alpha);
1543 }
1544
1545#ifdef HAVE_CUDA
1546 Ptr<BackendNode> initCUDA(int target, csl::Stream stream)
1547 {
1548 return make_cuda_node<cuda4dnn::ELUOp>(target, stream, alpha);
1549 }
1550#endif

1554 const std::vector<Ptr<BackendWrapper> > &inputs,

1556 {
1557 auto x = inputs[0].dynamicCast<CannBackendWrapper>();
1558
1559 auto op = std::make_shared<ge::op::Elu>(name);
1560
1561 op->set_attr_alpha(alpha);
1562
1563 auto op_x = nodes[0].dynamicCast<CannBackendNode>()->getOp();
1564 op->set_input_x_by_name(*op_x, x->name.c_str());
1565 auto x_desc = x->getTensorDesc();
1566 op->update_input_desc_x(*x_desc);
1567
1568 auto output_desc = std::make_shared<ge::TensorDesc>(ge::Shape(), ge::FORMAT_NCHW, ge::DT_FLOAT);
1569 op->update_output_desc_y(*output_desc);
1570
1571 return Ptr<BackendNode>(new CannBackendNode(op));

1573#endif // HAVE_CANN

1579 }
1580#endif // HAVE_DNN_NGRAPH

1649template<>
1650struct ElementWiseIntDispatch<AbsValFunctor>
1651{
1652 static inline bool supports(const AbsValFunctor&, int depth) { return isIntegerDepth(depth); }
1653
1654 static inline bool apply(const AbsValFunctor&, const Mat& src, Mat& dst)
1655 {
1656 if (src.type() != dst.type())
1657 return false;
1658
1659 // |x| leaves an unsigned value unchanged.
1660 if (isUnsignedDepth(src.depth()))
1661 {
1662 src.copyTo(dst);
1663 return true;
1664 }
1665 return intUnaryDispatch<IntAbsOp>(src, dst);
1666 }
1667};

1669struct BNLLFunctor : public BaseDefaultFunctor<BNLLFunctor>
1670{
1671 typedef BNLLLayer Layer;
1672
1673 ActivationFunc getActivationFunc(int depth, std::vector<float>& activParams) const
1674 {
1675 if (depth != CV_32F)
1676 return nullptr;
1677 activParams.clear();
1678 return cv::dnn::getActivationFunc(ACTIV_BNLL);
1679 }
1680
1681 bool supportBackend(int backendId, int)
1682 {
1683 return backendId == DNN_BACKEND_OPENCV ||
1684 backendId == DNN_BACKEND_CUDA ||
1685 backendId == DNN_BACKEND_CANN;
1686 }
1687
1688 inline float calculate(float x) const
1689 {
1690 // https://github.com/BVLC/caffe/blame/1.0/src/caffe/layers/bnll_layer.cpp#L17
1691 return x > 0 ? x + log(1.f + exp(-x)) : log(1.f + exp(x));
1692 }
1693
1694 void apply(const float* srcptr, float* dstptr, int stripeStart, int len, size_t planeSize, int cn0, int cn1) const
1695 {
1696 CV_UNUSED(stripeStart);
1697 for (int cn = cn0; cn < cn1; cn++, srcptr += planeSize, dstptr += planeSize)
1698 {
1699 int i = 0;
1700#if (CV_SIMD || CV_SIMD_SCALABLE)
1701 const int vlanes = VTraits<v_float32>::vlanes();
1702 v_float32 one = vx_setall_f32(1.f), z = vx_setzero_f32();
1703 for (; i <= len - vlanes; i += vlanes)
1704 {
1705 v_float32 x = vx_load(srcptr + i);
1706 // stable single-branch form: max(x,0) + log(1 + exp(-|x|))
1707 vx_store(dstptr + i, v_add(v_max(x, z), v_log(v_add(one, v_exp(v_sub(z, v_abs(x)))))));
1708 }
1709#endif
1710 for (; i < len; i++)
1711 dstptr[i] = calculate(srcptr[i]);
1712 }
1713 }
1714

1716 Ptr<BackendNode> initCUDA(int target, csl::Stream stream)
1717 {
1718 return make_cuda_node<cuda4dnn::BNLLOp>(target, stream);
1719 }
1720#endif

1723 Ptr<BackendNode> initCannOp(const std::string& name,
1724 const std::vector<Ptr<BackendWrapper> > &inputs,

1726 {
1727 auto x = inputs[0].dynamicCast<CannBackendWrapper>();
1728
1729 auto op = std::make_shared<ge::op::BNLL>(name);
1730
1731 auto op_x = nodes[0].dynamicCast<CannBackendNode>()->getOp();
1732 op->set_input_x_by_name(*op_x, x->name.c_str());
1733 auto x_desc = x->getTensorDesc();
1734 op->update_input_desc_x(*x_desc);
1735
1736 auto output_desc = std::make_shared<ge::TensorDesc>(ge::Shape(), ge::FORMAT_NCHW, ge::DT_FLOAT);
1737 op->update_output_desc_y(*output_desc);
1738
1739 return Ptr<BackendNode>(new CannBackendNode(op));
1740 }
1741#endif // HAVE_CANN

1898struct RoundFunctor : public BaseDefaultFunctor<RoundFunctor>
1899{
1900 typedef RoundLayer Layer;
1901
1902 bool supportBackend(int backendId, int)
1903 {
1904 return backendId == DNN_BACKEND_OPENCV || backendId == DNN_BACKEND_CUDA;
1905 }
1906
1907 inline float calculate(float x) const
1908 {
1909 // Rounds to even numbers in halfway cases, so 2.5 -> 2, -2.5 -> -2
1910 int old_rounding_direction = fegetround();
1911 fesetround(FE_TONEAREST);
1912 float y = std::nearbyint(x);
1913 fesetround(old_rounding_direction);
1914 return y;
1915 }
1916

1918 Ptr<BackendNode> initCUDA(int target, csl::Stream stream)
1919 {

2075struct AsinhFunctor : public BaseDefaultFunctor<AsinhFunctor>
2076{
2077 typedef AsinhLayer Layer;
2078
2079 ActivationFunc getActivationFunc(int depth, std::vector<float>& activParams) const
2080 {
2081 if (depth != CV_32F)
2082 return nullptr;
2083 activParams.clear();
2084 return cv::dnn::getActivationFunc(ACTIV_ASINH);
2085 }
2086
2087 bool supportBackend(int backendId, int)
2088 {
2089 return backendId == DNN_BACKEND_OPENCV || backendId == DNN_BACKEND_CUDA;
2090 }
2091
2092 inline float calculate(float x) const
2093 {
2094 return asinh(x);
2095 }
2096
2097 void apply(const float* srcptr, float* dstptr, int stripeStart, int len, size_t planeSize, int cn0, int cn1) const
2098 {
2099 CV_UNUSED(stripeStart);
2100 for (int cn = cn0; cn < cn1; cn++, srcptr += planeSize, dstptr += planeSize)
2101 {
2102 int i = 0;
2103#if (CV_SIMD || CV_SIMD_SCALABLE)
2104 const int vlanes = VTraits<v_float32>::vlanes();
2105 v_float32 one = vx_setall_f32(1.f), z = vx_setzero_f32();
2106 for (; i <= len - vlanes; i += vlanes)
2107 {
2108 v_float32 x = vx_load(srcptr + i);
2109 v_float32 ax = v_abs(x);
2110 v_float32 r = v_log(v_add(ax, v_sqrt(v_fma(ax, ax, one))));
2111 vx_store(dstptr + i, v_select(v_lt(x, z), v_sub(z, r), r));
2112 }
2113#endif
2114 for (; i < len; i++)
2115 dstptr[i] = calculate(srcptr[i]);
2116 }
2117 }

2374struct HardSwishFunctor : public BaseDefaultFunctor<HardSwishFunctor>
2375{
2376 using Layer = HardSwishLayer;
2377 int vlanes;
2378
2379 explicit HardSwishFunctor() {
2380#if (CV_SIMD || CV_SIMD_SCALABLE)
2381 vlanes = VTraits<v_float32>::vlanes();
2382#else
2383 vlanes = 1;
2384#endif
2385 }
2386
2387 ActivationFunc getActivationFunc(int depth, std::vector<float>& activParams) const
2388 {
2389 if (depth != CV_32F) return nullptr;
2390 activParams.clear();
2391 return cv::dnn::getActivationFunc(ACTIV_HARDSWISH);
2392 }
2393
2394 bool supportBackend(int backendId, int)
2395 {
2396 return backendId == DNN_BACKEND_OPENCV ||
2397 backendId == DNN_BACKEND_CUDA ||
2398 backendId == DNN_BACKEND_CANN;
2399 }
2400
2401 inline float calculate(float x) const
2402 {
2403 return x * std::max(0.f, std::min(1.f, x / 6.f + 0.5f));
2404 }
2405
2406 void apply(const float* srcptr, float* dstptr, int stripeStart, int len, size_t planeSize, int cn0, int cn1) const {
2407 CV_UNUSED(stripeStart);
2408 for (int cn = cn0; cn < cn1; cn++, srcptr += planeSize, dstptr += planeSize) {
2409 int i = 0;
2410#if (CV_SIMD || CV_SIMD_SCALABLE)
2411 v_float32 zero = vx_setzero_f32(), one = vx_setall_f32(1.0f),
2412 half = vx_setall_f32(0.5f), sixth = vx_setall_f32(1 / 6.0f);
2413 for (; i <= len - vlanes; i += vlanes) {
2414 v_float32 x = vx_load(srcptr + i);
2415
2416 v_float32 t = v_add(v_mul(x, sixth), half);
2417 t = v_min(one, t);
2418 t = v_max(zero, t);
2419 t = v_mul(x, t);
2420
2421 vx_store(dstptr + i, t);
2422 }
2423#endif
2424 // In case SIMD is not available or len > vlanes
2425 for (; i < len; i++) {
2426 dstptr[i] = calculate(srcptr[i]);
2427 }
2428 }
2429 }
2430
2431#ifdef HAVE_CUDA
2432 Ptr<BackendNode> initCUDA(int target, csl::Stream stream)
2433 {
2434 return make_cuda_node<cuda4dnn::HardSwishOp>(target, stream);
2435 }
2436#endif
2437
2438#ifdef HAVE_CANN
2439 Ptr<BackendNode> initCannOp(const std::string& name,
2440 const std::vector<Ptr<BackendWrapper> > &inputs,
2441 const std::vector<Ptr<BackendNode> >& nodes)
2442 {
2443 auto x = inputs[0].dynamicCast<CannBackendWrapper>();
2444
2445 auto op = std::make_shared<ge::op::HardSwish>(name);
2446
2447 auto op_x = nodes[0].dynamicCast<CannBackendNode>()->getOp();
2448 op->set_input_x_by_name(*op_x, x->name.c_str());
2449 auto x_desc = x->getTensorDesc();
2450 op->update_input_desc_x(*x_desc);
2451
2452 auto output_desc = std::make_shared<ge::TensorDesc>(ge::Shape(), ge::FORMAT_NCHW, ge::DT_FLOAT);
2453 op->update_output_desc_y(*output_desc);
2454
2455 return Ptr<BackendNode>(new CannBackendNode(op));
2456 }
2457#endif
2458
2459 int64 getFLOPSPerElement() const { return 1; }
2460};

2599 for (int cn = cn0; cn < cn1; cn++, srcptr += planeSize, dstptr += planeSize)
2600 {
2601 int i = 0;
2602#if (CV_SIMD || CV_SIMD_SCALABLE)
2603 const int vlanes = VTraits<v_float32>::vlanes();
2604 v_float32 one = vx_setall_f32(1.f);
2605 for (; i <= len - vlanes; i += vlanes)
2606 {
2607 v_float32 x = vx_load(srcptr + i);
2608 vx_store(dstptr + i, v_log(v_add(one, v_exp(x))));
2609 }
2610#endif
2611 for (; i < len; i++)
2612 dstptr[i] = calculate(srcptr[i]);
2613 }
2614 }

2620 }
2621#endif

2710struct CeluFunctor : public BaseDefaultFunctor<CeluFunctor>
2711{
2712 using Layer = CeluLayer;
2713
2714 float alpha;
2715 int vlanes;
2716
2717 explicit CeluFunctor(float alpha_ = 1.f) : alpha(alpha_) {
2718#if (CV_SIMD || CV_SIMD_SCALABLE)
2719 vlanes = VTraits<v_float32>::vlanes();
2720#else
2721 vlanes = 1;
2722#endif
2723 }
2724
2725 bool supportBackend(int backendId, int)
2726 {
2727 return backendId == DNN_BACKEND_OPENCV || backendId == DNN_BACKEND_CUDA;
2728 }
2729
2730 inline float calculate(float x) const
2731 {
2732 return std::max(0.f, x) + std::min(0.f, alpha * expm1(x / alpha));
2733 }
2734
2735 void apply(const float* srcptr, float* dstptr, int stripeStart, int len, size_t planeSize, int cn0, int cn1) const {
2736 CV_UNUSED(stripeStart);
2737 for (int cn = cn0; cn < cn1; cn++, srcptr += planeSize, dstptr += planeSize) {
2738 int i = 0;
2739#if (CV_SIMD || CV_SIMD_SCALABLE)
2740 v_float32 zero = vx_setzero_f32(), v_alpha = vx_setall_f32(alpha),
2741 one = vx_setall_f32(1.0f), v_ralpha = vx_setall_f32(1.0f / alpha);
2742 for (; i <= len - vlanes; i += vlanes) {
2743 v_float32 x = vx_load(srcptr + i);
2744
2745 v_float32 t = v_min(zero, v_mul(v_alpha, v_sub(v_exp(v_mul(x, v_ralpha)), one)));
2746 t = v_add(v_max(zero, x), t);
2747
2748 vx_store(dstptr + i, t);
2749 }
2750#endif
2751 // In case SIMD is not available or len < vlanes
2752 for (; i < len; i++) {
2753 dstptr[i] = calculate(srcptr[i]);
2754 }
2755 }
2756 }
2757
2758 inline void setKernelParams(ocl::Kernel& kernel) const
2759 {
2760 kernel.set(3, alpha);
2761 }
2762
2763#ifdef HAVE_CUDA
2764 Ptr<BackendNode> initCUDA(int target, csl::Stream stream)
2765 {
2766 return make_cuda_node<cuda4dnn::CeluOp>(target, stream, alpha);
2767 }
2768#endif
2769
2770 int64 getFLOPSPerElement() const { return 1; }
2771};

2821struct SeluFunctor : public BaseDefaultFunctor<SeluFunctor>
2822{
2823 using Layer = SeluLayer;
2824
2825 float alpha;
2826 float gamma;
2827 int vlanes;
2828
2829 explicit SeluFunctor(float alpha_ = 1.67326319217681884765625f,
2830 float gamma_ = 1.05070102214813232421875f)
2831 : alpha(alpha_), gamma(gamma_) {
2832#if (CV_SIMD || CV_SIMD_SCALABLE)
2833 vlanes = VTraits<v_float32>::vlanes();
2834#else
2835 vlanes = 1;
2836#endif
2837 }
2838
2839 bool supportBackend(int backendId, int)
2840 {
2841 return backendId == DNN_BACKEND_OPENCV || backendId == DNN_BACKEND_CUDA;
2842 }
2843
2844 inline float calculate(float x) const
2845 {
2846 return gamma * (x > 0.f ? x : alpha * expm1(x));
2847 }
2848
2849 void apply(const float* srcptr, float* dstptr, int stripeStart, int len, size_t planeSize, int cn0, int cn1) const {
2850 CV_UNUSED(stripeStart);
2851 for (int cn = cn0; cn < cn1; cn++, srcptr += planeSize, dstptr += planeSize) {
2852 int i = 0;
2853#if (CV_SIMD || CV_SIMD_SCALABLE)
2854 v_float32 z = vx_setzero_f32(), one = vx_setall_f32(1.0f),
2855 v_alpha = vx_setall_f32(alpha), v_gamma = vx_setall_f32(gamma);
2856 for (; i <= len - vlanes; i += vlanes) {
2857 v_float32 x = vx_load(srcptr + i);
2858
2859 v_float32 t = v_mul(v_alpha, v_sub(v_exp(x), one));
2860 x = v_select(v_le(x, z), t, x);
2861 x = v_mul(v_gamma, x);
2862
2863 vx_store(dstptr + i, x);
2864 }
2865#endif
2866 // In case SIMD is not available or len > vlanes
2867 for (; i < len; i++) {
2868 dstptr[i] = calculate(srcptr[i]);
2869 }
2870 }
2871 }
2872
2873 inline void setKernelParams(ocl::Kernel& kernel) const
2874 {
2875 kernel.set(3, alpha);
2876 kernel.set(4, gamma);
2877 }
2878

2880 Ptr<BackendNode> initCUDA(int target, csl::Stream stream)
2881 {
2882 return make_cuda_node<cuda4dnn::SeluOp>(target, stream, alpha, gamma);
2883 }
2884#endif
2885
2886 int64 getFLOPSPerElement() const { return 1; }
2887};

2929struct PowerFunctor : public BaseFunctor
2930{
2931 typedef PowerLayer Layer;
2932
2933 float power, scale, shift;
2934 float originPower, originScale, originShift;
2935
2936 explicit PowerFunctor(float power_ = 1.f, float scale_ = 1.f, float shift_ = 0.f)
2937 : power(power_), scale(scale_), shift(shift_),
2938 originPower(power_), originScale(scale_), originShift(shift_) {}
2939
2940 bool supportBackend(int backendId, int targetId)
2941 {
2942#ifdef HAVE_INF_ENGINE
2943 if (backendId == DNN_BACKEND_INFERENCE_ENGINE_NGRAPH)
2944 return true;
2945#endif
2946 {
2947 return backendId == DNN_BACKEND_OPENCV ||
2948 backendId == DNN_BACKEND_CUDA;
2949 }
2950 }
2951
2952 void finalize()
2953 {
2954 power = originPower;
2955 scale = originScale;
2956 shift = originShift;
2957 }
2958
2959 void apply(const float* srcptr, float* dstptr, int stripeStart, int len, size_t planeSize, int cn0, int cn1) const
2960 {
2961 CV_UNUSED(stripeStart);
2962 float a = scale, b = shift, p = power;
2963 if( p == 1.f )
2964 {
2965 for( int cn = cn0; cn < cn1; cn++, srcptr += planeSize, dstptr += planeSize )
2966 {
2967 for( int i = 0; i < len; i++ )
2968 {
2969 float x = srcptr[i];
2970 dstptr[i] = a*x + b;
2971 }
2972 }
2973 }
2974 else
2975 {
2976 for( int cn = cn0; cn < cn1; cn++, srcptr += planeSize, dstptr += planeSize )
2977 {
2978 for( int i = 0; i < len; i++ )
2979 {
2980 float x = srcptr[i];
2981 dstptr[i] = std::pow(a*x + b, p);
2982 }
2983 }
2984 }
2985 }
2986
2987#ifdef HAVE_OPENCL
2988 bool applyOCL(InputArrayOfArrays inps, OutputArrayOfArrays outs, OutputArrayOfArrays internals)
2989 {
2990 std::vector<UMat> inputs;
2991 std::vector<UMat> outputs;
2992
2993 inps.getUMatVector(inputs);
2994 outs.getUMatVector(outputs);
2995 String buildopt = oclGetTMacro(inputs[0]);
2996
2997 for (size_t i = 0; i < inputs.size(); i++)
2998 {
2999 UMat& src = inputs[i];
3000 UMat& dst = outputs[i];
3001
3002 ocl::Kernel kernel("PowForward", ocl::dnn::activations_oclsrc, buildopt);
3003 kernel.set(0, (int)src.total());
3004 kernel.set(1, ocl::KernelArg::PtrReadOnly(src));
3005 kernel.set(2, ocl::KernelArg::PtrWriteOnly(dst));
3006 kernel.set(3, (float)power);
3007 kernel.set(4, (float)scale);
3008 kernel.set(5, (float)shift);
3009
3010 size_t gSize = src.total();
3011 CV_Assert(kernel.run(1, &gSize, NULL, false));
3012 }
3013
3014 return true;
3015 }
3016#endif

3035 std::shared_ptr<ov::Node> initNgraphAPI(const ov::Output<ov::Node>& node)
3036 {
3037 auto scale_node = std::make_shared<ov::op::v0::Constant>(ov::element::f32,
3038 ov::Shape{1}, &scale);
3039 auto shift_node = std::make_shared<ov::op::v0::Constant>(ov::element::f32,
3040 ov::Shape{1}, &shift);
3041
3042 auto mul = std::make_shared<ov::op::v1::Multiply>(scale_node, node, ov::op::AutoBroadcastType::NUMPY);
3043 auto scale_shift = std::make_shared<ov::op::v1::Add>(mul, shift_node, ov::op::AutoBroadcastType::NUMPY);
3044
3045 if (power == 1)
3046 return scale_shift;
3047
3048 auto power_node = std::make_shared<ov::op::v0::Constant>(ov::element::f32,
3049 ov::Shape{1}, &power);
3050 return std::make_shared<ov::op::v1::Power>(scale_shift, power_node, ov::op::AutoBroadcastType::NUMPY);
3051 }

3054#ifdef HAVE_WEBNN
3055 ml::Operand initWebnnAPI(const ml::GraphBuilder& builder, const ml::Operand& input)
3056 {
3057 CV_Error(Error::StsNotImplemented, "");
3058 ml::Operand operand;
3059 return operand;

3061#endif
3062
3063 bool tryFuse(Ptr<dnn::Layer>& top)
3064 {
3065 if (power != 1.0f && shift != 0.0f)
3066 return false;
3067
3068 Mat w, b;
3069 top->getScaleShift(w, b);
3070 if ((w.empty() && b.empty()) || w.total() > 1 || b.total() > 1)
3071 return false;
3072
3073 float nextScale = w.empty() ? 1.0f : w.at<float>(0);
3074 float nextShift = b.empty() ? 0.0f : b.at<float>(0);
3075 scale = std::pow(scale, power) * nextScale;
3076 shift = nextScale * shift + nextShift;
3077 return true;
3078 }
3079
3080 void getScaleShift(Mat& _scale, Mat& _shift) const
3081 {
3082 if (power == 1.0f)
3083 {
3084 _scale = Mat(1, 1, CV_32F, Scalar(scale));
3085 _shift = Mat(1, 1, CV_32F, Scalar(shift));
3086 }
3087 }
3088
3089 int64 getFLOPSPerElement() const { return power == 1 ? 2 : 10; }
3090};

3092// This is required for ONNX Neg on integer tensors produced by Shape/Size subgraphs.
3093template<>
3094struct ElementWiseIntDispatch<PowerFunctor>
3095{
3096 // Only the degenerate form is representable in integers, so support depends on the
3097 // functor's parameters and not on the depth alone.
3098 static inline bool integerScale(const PowerFunctor& func, int64_t& scale)
3099 {
3100 if (func.power != 1.f)
3101 return false;
3102 if (func.shift != 0.f)
3103 return false;
3104
3105 // scale must be an integer value (Neg uses scale=-1)
3106 const double scale_d = (double)func.scale;
3107 if (std::floor(scale_d) != scale_d)
3108 return false;
3109 scale = (int64_t)scale_d;
3110 return true;
3111 }
3112
3113 static inline bool supports(const PowerFunctor& func, int depth)
3114 {
3115 int64_t scale;
3116 return (depth == CV_32S || depth == CV_64S) && integerScale(func, scale);
3117 }
3118
3119 static inline bool apply(const PowerFunctor& func, const Mat& src, Mat& dst)
3120 {
3121 if (src.type() != dst.type())
3122 return false;
3123 const int depth = src.depth();
3124 if (depth != CV_32S && depth != CV_64S)
3125 return false;
3126
3127 int64_t scale;
3128 if (!integerScale(func, scale))
3129 return false;
3130
3131 const size_t n = src.total();
3132 if (depth == CV_32S)
3133 {
3134 const int32_t* sp = src.ptr<int32_t>();
3135 int32_t* dp = dst.ptr<int32_t>();
3136 for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i)
3137 dp[i] = (int32_t)((int64_t)sp[i] * scale);
3138 return true;
3139 }
3140 else // CV_64S
3141 {
3142 const int64_t* sp = src.ptr<int64_t>();
3143 int64_t* dp = dst.ptr<int64_t>();
3144 // Unsigned so the wrap at the type minimum is defined rather than overflow.
3145 for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i)
3146 dp[i] = (int64_t)((uint64_t)sp[i] * (uint64_t)scale);
3147 return true;
3148 }
3149 }
3150};
3151
3152struct ExpFunctor : public BaseDefaultFunctor<ExpFunctor>
3153{
3154 typedef ExpLayer Layer;
3155
3156 ActivationFunc getActivationFunc(int depth, std::vector<float>& activParams) const
3157 {
3158 if (depth != CV_32F)
3159 return nullptr;
3160 activParams = {normScale, normShift};
3161 return cv::dnn::getActivationFunc(ACTIV_EXP);
3162 }
3163 float base, scale, shift;
3164 float normScale, normShift;
3165
3166 ExpFunctor(float base_ = -1.f, float scale_ = 1.f, float shift_ = 0.f)
3167 : base(base_), scale(scale_), shift(shift_)
3168 {
3169 // For base > 0 :
3170 // y = base^(scale * input + shift)
3171 // ln(y) = ln(base)*(scale * input + shift)
3172 // y = exp((ln(base)*scale) * input + (ln(base)*shift))
3173 // y = exp(normalized_scale * input + normalized_shift)
3174 CV_Check(base, base == -1.f || base > 0.f, "Unsupported 'base' value");
3175 const float ln_base = (base == -1.f) ? 1.f : log(base);
3176 normScale = scale * ln_base;
3177 normShift = shift * ln_base;
3178 }
3179
3180 bool supportBackend(int backendId, int targetId)
3181 {
3182 return backendId == DNN_BACKEND_OPENCV || backendId == DNN_BACKEND_CUDA ||
3183 backendId == DNN_BACKEND_INFERENCE_ENGINE_NGRAPH;
3184 }
3185
3186 inline float calculate(float x) const
3187 {
3188 return exp(normScale * x + normShift);
3189 }
3190
3191 void apply(const float* srcptr, float* dstptr, int stripeStart, int len, size_t planeSize, int cn0, int cn1) const
3192 {
3193 CV_UNUSED(stripeStart);
3194 for (int cn = cn0; cn < cn1; cn++, srcptr += planeSize, dstptr += planeSize)
3195 {
3196 int i = 0;
3197#if (CV_SIMD || CV_SIMD_SCALABLE)
3198 const int vlanes = VTraits<v_float32>::vlanes();
3199 v_float32 vsc = vx_setall_f32(normScale), vsh = vx_setall_f32(normShift);
3200 for (; i <= len - vlanes; i += vlanes)
3201 {
3202 v_float32 x = vx_load(srcptr + i);
3203 vx_store(dstptr + i, v_exp(v_fma(x, vsc, vsh)));
3204 }
3205#endif
3206 for (; i < len; i++)
3207 dstptr[i] = calculate(srcptr[i]);
3208 }
3209 }
3210
3211 inline void setKernelParams(ocl::Kernel& kernel) const
3212 {
3213 kernel.set(3, normScale);
3214 kernel.set(4, normShift);
3215 }
3216
3217#ifdef HAVE_CUDA
3218 Ptr<BackendNode> initCUDA(int target, csl::Stream stream)
3219 {
3220 return make_cuda_node<cuda4dnn::ExpOp>(target, stream, normScale, normShift);
3221 }
3222#endif
3223
3224#ifdef HAVE_DNN_NGRAPH
3225 std::shared_ptr<ov::Node> initNgraphAPI(const ov::Output<ov::Node>& node)
3226 {
3227 auto scale_node = std::make_shared<ov::op::v0::Constant>(ov::element::f32,
3228 ov::Shape{1}, &normScale);
3229 auto shift_node = std::make_shared<ov::op::v0::Constant>(ov::element::f32,
3230 ov::Shape{1}, &normShift);
3231 auto mul = std::make_shared<ov::op::v1::Multiply>(scale_node, node, ov::op::AutoBroadcastType::NUMPY);
3232 auto scale_shift = std::make_shared<ov::op::v1::Add>(mul, shift_node, ov::op::AutoBroadcastType::NUMPY);
3233 return std::make_shared<ov::op::v0::Exp>(scale_shift);
3234 }
3235#endif // HAVE_DNN_NGRAPH
3236
3237 int64 getFLOPSPerElement() const { return 3; }
3238};

3243struct ChannelsPReLUFunctor : public BaseFunctor
3244{
3245 typedef ChannelsPReLULayer Layer;
3246 Mat scale;
3247#ifdef HAVE_OPENCL
3248 UMat scale_umat;
3249 std::string oclKernelName = "ChannelsPReLUForward";
3250#endif
3251
3252 explicit ChannelsPReLUFunctor(const Mat& scale_=Mat()) : scale(scale_)
3253 {
3254 }
3255
3256 bool supportBackend(int backendId, int)
3257 {
3258#ifdef HAVE_INF_ENGINE
3259 if (backendId == DNN_BACKEND_INFERENCE_ENGINE_NGRAPH)
3260 return true;
3261#endif
3262 return backendId == DNN_BACKEND_OPENCV ||
3263 backendId == DNN_BACKEND_CUDA ||
3264 backendId == DNN_BACKEND_CANN;
3265 }
3266
3267 void apply(const float* srcptr, float* dstptr, int stripeStart, int len, size_t planeSize, int cn0, int cn1) const
3268 {
3269 CV_UNUSED(stripeStart);
3270 CV_Assert(scale.isContinuous() && scale.type() == CV_32F);
3271
3272 const float* scaleptr = scale.ptr<float>();
3273 CV_Assert( 0 <= cn0 && cn0 < cn1 && cn1 <= (int)scale.total() );
3274
3275 for( int cn = cn0; cn < cn1; cn++, srcptr += planeSize, dstptr += planeSize )
3276 {
3277 float s = scaleptr[cn];
3278 int i = 0;
3279 #if CV_SIMD128
3280 v_float32x4 s4 = v_setall_f32(s), z = v_setzero_f32();
3281 for( ; i <= len - 16; i += 16 )
3282 {
3283 v_float32x4 x0 = v_load(srcptr + i);
3284 v_float32x4 x1 = v_load(srcptr + i + 4);
3285 v_float32x4 x2 = v_load(srcptr + i + 8);
3286 v_float32x4 x3 = v_load(srcptr + i + 12);
3287 x0 = v_select(v_ge(x0, z), x0, v_mul(x0, s4));
3288 x1 = v_select(v_ge(x1, z), x1, v_mul(x1, s4));
3289 x2 = v_select(v_ge(x2, z), x2, v_mul(x2, s4));
3290 x3 = v_select(v_ge(x3, z), x3, v_mul(x3, s4));
3291 v_store(dstptr + i, x0);
3292 v_store(dstptr + i + 4, x1);
3293 v_store(dstptr + i + 8, x2);
3294 v_store(dstptr + i + 12, x3);
3295 }
3296 #endif
3297 for( ; i < len; i++ )
3298 {
3299 float x = srcptr[i];
3300 dstptr[i] = x >= 0.f ? x : s*x;
3301 }
3302 }
3303 }
3304
3305#ifdef HAVE_OPENCL
3306 bool applyOCL(InputArrayOfArrays inps, OutputArrayOfArrays outs, OutputArrayOfArrays internals)
3307 {
3308 if (scale_umat.empty())
3309 scale.copyTo(scale_umat);
3310
3311 std::vector<UMat> inputs;
3312 std::vector<UMat> outputs;
3313
3314 inps.getUMatVector(inputs);
3315 outs.getUMatVector(outputs);
3316 String buildopt = oclGetTMacro(inputs[0]);
3317
3318 for (size_t i = 0; i < inputs.size(); i++)
3319 {
3320 UMat& src = inputs[i];
3321 UMat& dst = outputs[i];
3322
3323 ocl::Kernel kernel(oclKernelName.c_str(), ocl::dnn::activations_oclsrc, buildopt);
3324 kernel.set(0, (int)src.total());
3325 kernel.set(1, (int)src.size[1]);
3326 kernel.set(2, (int)total(shape(src), 2));
3327 kernel.set(3, ocl::KernelArg::PtrReadOnly(src));
3328 kernel.set(4, ocl::KernelArg::PtrWriteOnly(dst));
3329 kernel.set(5, ocl::KernelArg::PtrReadOnly(scale_umat));
3330
3331 size_t gSize = src.total();
3332 CV_Assert(kernel.run(1, &gSize, NULL, false));
3333 }
3334
3335 return true;
3336 }
3337#endif
3338
3339#ifdef HAVE_CUDA
3340 Ptr<BackendNode> initCUDA(int target, csl::Stream stream)
3341 {
3342 return make_cuda_node<cuda4dnn::ChannelwiseReLUOp>(target, stream, scale);
3343 }
3344#endif
3345
3346#ifdef HAVE_CANN
3347 Ptr<BackendNode> initCannOp(const std::string& name,
3348 const std::vector<Ptr<BackendWrapper> > &inputs,
3349 const std::vector<Ptr<BackendNode> >& nodes)
3350 {
3351 auto x = inputs[0].dynamicCast<CannBackendWrapper>();
3352 auto op_x = nodes[0].dynamicCast<CannBackendNode>()->getOp();
3353 auto x_desc = x->getTensorDesc();
3354
3355 auto output_desc = std::make_shared<ge::TensorDesc>(ge::Shape(), ge::FORMAT_NCHW, ge::DT_FLOAT);
3356
3357 auto op = std::make_shared<ge::op::PRelu>(name);
3358
3359 op->set_input_x_by_name(*op_x, x->name.c_str());
3360 op->update_input_desc_x(*x_desc);
3361
3362 std::vector<int> shape_{scale.size[0]}; // scale should be a 1d of shape [n] tensor, and it is a 2d mat of shape [n, 1] in opencv
3363 auto op_const_slope = std::make_shared<CannConstOp>(scale.data, scale.type(), shape_, cv::format("%s_weight", name.c_str()));
3364 op->set_input_weight(*(op_const_slope->getOp()));
3365 op->update_input_desc_weight(*(op_const_slope->getTensorDesc()));
3366
3367 op->update_output_desc_y(*output_desc);
3368
3369 return Ptr<BackendNode>(new CannBackendNode(op));
3370 }
3371#endif // HAVE_CANN
3372
3373#ifdef HAVE_DNN_NGRAPH
3374 std::shared_ptr<ov::Node> initNgraphAPI(const ov::Output<ov::Node>& node)
3375 {
3376 const size_t numChannels = scale.total();
3377 auto slope = std::make_shared<ov::op::v0::Constant>(ov::element::f32, ov::Shape{numChannels}, scale.data);
3378 return std::make_shared<ov::op::v0::PRelu>(node, slope);
3379 }
3380#endif // HAVE_DNN_NGRAPH
3381
3382#ifdef HAVE_WEBNN
3383 ml::Operand initWebnnAPI(const ml::GraphBuilder& builder, const ml::Operand& input)
3384 {
3385 CV_Error(Error::StsNotImplemented, "");
3386 ml::Operand operand;
3387 return operand;
3388 }
3389#endif
3390
3391 int64 getFLOPSPerElement() const { return 1; }
3392};

3394struct PReLUFunctor : public ChannelsPReLUFunctor
3395{
3396 explicit PReLUFunctor(const Mat& scale_=Mat()) : ChannelsPReLUFunctor(scale_)
3397 {
3398#ifdef HAVE_OPENCL
3399 oclKernelName = "PReLUForward";
3400#endif
3401 }
3402
3403 bool supportBackend(int backendId, int)
3404 {
3405 return backendId == DNN_BACKEND_OPENCV ||
3406 backendId == DNN_BACKEND_CANN ||
3407 backendId == DNN_BACKEND_INFERENCE_ENGINE_NGRAPH;
3408 }
3409
3410 void apply(const float* srcptr, float* dstptr, int stripeStart, int len, size_t planeSize, int cn0, int cn1) const
3411 {
3412 CV_UNUSED(stripeStart);
3413 CV_Assert(scale.isContinuous() && scale.type() == CV_32F);
3414
3415 if (stripeStart < 0)
3416 CV_Error(Error::StsNotImplemented, "PReLUFunctor requires stripe offset parameter");
3417
3418 const float* scaleptr = scale.ptr<float>() + cn0 * planeSize + stripeStart;
3419 for( int cn = cn0; cn < cn1; cn++, srcptr += planeSize, dstptr += planeSize, scaleptr += planeSize )
3420 {
3421 int i = 0;
3422 #if CV_SIMD128
3423 v_float32x4 z = v_setzero_f32();
3424 for( ; i <= len - 16; i += 16 )
3425 {
3426 v_float32x4 x0 = v_load(srcptr + i);
3427 v_float32x4 x1 = v_load(srcptr + i + 4);
3428 v_float32x4 x2 = v_load(srcptr + i + 8);
3429 v_float32x4 x3 = v_load(srcptr + i + 12);
3430 v_float32x4 s0 = v_load(scaleptr + i);
3431 v_float32x4 s1 = v_load(scaleptr + i + 4);
3432 v_float32x4 s2 = v_load(scaleptr + i + 8);
3433 v_float32x4 s3 = v_load(scaleptr + i + 12);
3434 x0 = v_select(v_ge(x0, z), x0, v_mul(x0, s0));
3435 x1 = v_select(v_ge(x1, z), x1, v_mul(x1, s1));
3436 x2 = v_select(v_ge(x2, z), x2, v_mul(x2, s2));
3437 x3 = v_select(v_ge(x3, z), x3, v_mul(x3, s3));
3438 v_store(dstptr + i, x0);
3439 v_store(dstptr + i + 4, x1);
3440 v_store(dstptr + i + 8, x2);
3441 v_store(dstptr + i + 12, x3);
3442 }
3443 #endif
3444 for( ; i < len; i++ )
3445 {
3446 float x = srcptr[i];
3447 float s = scaleptr[i];
3448 dstptr[i] = x >= 0.f ? x : s*x;
3449 }
3450 }
3451 }
3452
3453#ifdef HAVE_DNN_NGRAPH
3454 std::shared_ptr<ov::Node> initNgraphAPI(const ov::Output<ov::Node>& node)
3455 {
3456 auto shape = getShape<size_t>(scale);
3457 auto slope = std::make_shared<ov::op::v0::Constant>(ov::element::f32, shape, scale.ptr<float>());
3458 return std::make_shared<ov::op::v0::PRelu>(node, slope);
3459 }
3460#endif // HAVE_DNN_NGRAPH
3461};

3503struct ShrinkFunctor : public BaseDefaultFunctor<ShrinkFunctor>
3504{
3505 typedef ShrinkLayer Layer;
3506 float bias;
3507 float lambd;
3508
3509 explicit ShrinkFunctor(float bias_ = 0.0f, float lambd_ = 0.5f) : bias(bias_), lambd(lambd_) {}
3510
3511 bool supportBackend(int backendId, int)
3512 {
3513 return backendId == DNN_BACKEND_OPENCV ||
3514 backendId == DNN_BACKEND_CUDA;
3515 }

3517 inline float calculate(float x) const
3518 {

3526 }
3527#endif

3530};

3893// Block-layout (NxC1xHxWxC0) aware override of per-channel PReLU.
3894class ChannelsPReLUImpl CV_FINAL : public ElementWiseLayer<ChannelsPReLUFunctor>
3895{
3896public:
3897 using ElementWiseLayer<ChannelsPReLUFunctor>::ElementWiseLayer;
3898
3899 void setSlope(const Mat& slope) CV_OVERRIDE
3900 {
3901 slope.reshape(1, (int)slope.total()).convertTo(func.scale, CV_32F);
3902#ifdef HAVE_OPENCL
3903 func.scale_umat.release();
3904#endif
3905 }
3906
3907 void forward(InputArrayOfArrays inputs_arr,
3908 OutputArrayOfArrays outputs_arr,
3909 OutputArrayOfArrays internals_arr) CV_OVERRIDE
3910 {
3911 CV_TRACE_FUNCTION();
3912
3913 std::vector<Mat> inputs, outputs;
3914 inputs_arr.getMatVector(inputs);
3915 outputs_arr.getMatVector(outputs);
3916 if (!inputs.empty() && inputs[0].shape().layout == DATA_LAYOUT_BLOCK)
3917 {
3918 CV_Assert(inputs.size() == outputs.size());
3919 for (size_t i = 0; i < inputs.size(); ++i)
3920 forwardBlock(inputs[i], outputs[i]);
3921 return;
3922 }
3923 ElementWiseLayer<ChannelsPReLUFunctor>::forward(inputs_arr, outputs_arr, internals_arr);
3924 }
3925
3926private:
3927 void forwardBlock(const Mat& src, Mat& dst) const
3928 {
3929 CV_Assert(src.type() == CV_32F && dst.type() == CV_32F);
3930 CV_Assert(src.dims == 5 && dst.dims == 5);
3931 CV_Assert(src.isContinuous() && dst.isContinuous());
3932
3933 const int N = src.size[0];
3934 const int C1 = src.size[1];
3935 const int H = src.size[2];
3936 const int W = src.size[3];
3937 const int C0 = src.size[4];
3938 const int Ci = (int)src.shape().C;
3939
3940 const float* scaleptr = func.scale.ptr<float>();
3941
3942 const size_t inStep0 = src.step.p[0] / sizeof(float);
3943 const size_t inStep1 = src.step.p[1] / sizeof(float);
3944 const size_t inStep2 = src.step.p[2] / sizeof(float);
3945 const size_t inStep3 = src.step.p[3] / sizeof(float);
3946
3947 const size_t outStep0 = dst.step.p[0] / sizeof(float);
3948 const size_t outStep1 = dst.step.p[1] / sizeof(float);
3949 const size_t outStep2 = dst.step.p[2] / sizeof(float);
3950 const size_t outStep3 = dst.step.p[3] / sizeof(float);
3951
3952#if CV_SIMD
3953 const int VEC_SZ = VTraits<v_float32>::vlanes();
3954#endif
3955
3956 parallel_for_(Range(0, N * C1), [&](const Range& r) {
3957 const float* inptr0 = src.ptr<float>();
3958 float* outptr0 = dst.ptr<float>();
3959 AutoBuffer<float> slopeBuf(C0);
3960 float* slopes = slopeBuf.data();
3961
3962 for (int i = r.start; i < r.end; ++i) {
3963 const int n = i / C1;
3964 const int c1 = i - n * C1;
3965 const int cbase = c1 * C0;
3966 const int validC0 = std::min(C0, std::max(0, Ci - cbase));
3967
3968 for (int c = 0; c < validC0; ++c)
3969 slopes[c] = scaleptr[cbase + c];
3970 for (int c = validC0; c < C0; ++c)
3971 slopes[c] = 0.f;
3972
3973 const float* inbase = inptr0 + n * inStep0 + c1 * inStep1;
3974 float* outbase = outptr0 + n * outStep0 + c1 * outStep1;
3975
3976#if CV_SIMD
3977 if (C0 == VEC_SZ) {
3978 v_float32 vslope = vx_load(slopes);
3979 v_float32 vzero = vx_setzero_f32();
3980 for (int h = 0; h < H; ++h) {
3981 const float* inrow = inbase + h * inStep2;
3982 float* outrow = outbase + h * outStep2;
3983 for (int w = 0; w < W; ++w) {
3984 v_float32 v = vx_load(inrow + w * inStep3);
3985 v_float32 scaled = v_mul(v, vslope);
3986 v_float32 out = v_select(v_ge(v, vzero), v, scaled);
3987 vx_store(outrow + w * outStep3, out);
3988 }
3989 }
3990 continue;
3991 }
3992#endif
3993 for (int h = 0; h < H; ++h) {
3994 const float* inrow = inbase + h * inStep2;
3995 float* outrow = outbase + h * outStep2;
3996 for (int w = 0; w < W; ++w) {
3997 const float* in_pos = inrow + w * inStep3;
3998 float* out_pos = outrow + w * outStep3;
3999 for (int c0 = 0; c0 < validC0; ++c0) {
4000 float v = in_pos[c0];
4001 out_pos[c0] = v >= 0.f ? v : slopes[c0] * v;
4002 }
4003 for (int c0 = validC0; c0 < C0; ++c0)
4004 out_pos[c0] = 0.f;
4005 }
4006 }
4007 }
4008 });
4009 }
4010};
4011
4012Ptr<Layer> ChannelsPReLULayer::create(const LayerParams& params)
4013{
4014 if (params.blobs.empty())
4015 {
4016 // Slope comes as a second input; constArgs() fills the scale in later.
4017 Ptr<ChannelsPReLUImpl> l(new ChannelsPReLUImpl(ChannelsPReLUFunctor()));
4018 l->setParamsFrom(params);
4019 return l;
4020 }
4021 CV_Assert(params.blobs.size() == 1);
4022 Mat scale = params.blobs[0];
4023 float slope = *scale.ptr<float>();
4024 if (scale.total() == 1 || countNonZero(scale != slope) == 0)
4025 {
4026 LayerParams reluParams = params;
4027 reluParams.set("negative_slope", slope);
4028 return ReLULayer::create(reluParams);
4029 }
4030
4031 Ptr<Layer> l;
4032 // Check first two dimensions of scale (batch, channels)
4033 MatShape scaleShape = shape(scale);
4034 if (std::count_if(scaleShape.begin(), scaleShape.end(), [](int d){ return d != 1;}) > 1)
4035 {
4036 l = new ElementWiseLayer<PReLUFunctor>(PReLUFunctor(scale));
4037 }
4038 else
4039 {
4040 l = new ChannelsPReLUImpl(ChannelsPReLUFunctor(scale));
4041 }
4042 l->setParamsFrom(params);
4043
4044 return l;
4045}

4067 Ptr<ShrinkLayer> l(new ElementWiseLayer<ShrinkFunctor>(ShrinkFunctor(bias, lambd)));
4068 l->setParamsFrom(params);
4069 l->bias = bias;
4070 l->lambd = lambd;
4071
4072 return l;
4073}
4074}
4075}
